description: Business-process scope for an SAP conversion, per Business Area: Changed/Unchanged/To-Assess/Out-of-scope, complexity, and (when an Application Map was cross-referenced) supporting applications. Produced by skills/conversion-scoping as a real .xlsx via build_scope_workbook.py.

notes.description: Must include the caveat that this is a planning-level draft to be re-validated during Fit-to-Standard/Design-phase workshops.

technical_blocker.description: true when driven by a Simplification Item consistency error needing engineering remediation, not a business decision. Read by workshop-preparation to exclude the row from the business-discussion agenda.

applications.description: Supporting application(s), only when an Application Map was cross-referenced.
